summary: Rent the Runway, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Third Amendment to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, establishing a $10 million incremental term loan facility for working capital and general corporate purposes. The amendment involves the company as borrower, lenders, and CHS (US) Management LLC as administrative agent. This is a routine credit facility modification, not a special situation. No price per share, premium, or structural changes to equity are mentioned. The filing is ordinary financing activity, so no special-situation classification applies.
